_about: CLIPBUILD clip_build.json: single source of truth for character clip builds (Tools/clip_build.py + Assets/Editor/CharacterClipBuild.cs). Every base state is built from a RAW Mixamo library clip onto the roster character own skeleton. No character is named in code: ids come from roster.json; characters{} only holds per-character overrides. A tuning profile is legal only for its owner (Joan profile = zero offsets = raw Mixamo; the Dracula crimson_v5 profile cannot be used by anyone else). Rows with "foreign" are explicit exceptions with a reason. attacks/dodges/finishers sets are listed under delegated and keep running through bake_attack_clips.py / bake_dodge_clips.py / FinisherClipSetup until merged.
skipReason: Pitborn keeps his legacy clips until reviewed: his body is not Mixamo-native (HC2) and his missing attack rows will come from the combat_clips_unity pack through enemyPackHook. Remove him from skipIds to build him (raw Mixamo, waiver gates).

scaleProfiles._about: SOBEKTUNE v1: gates for a character whose body is not Joan-sized. Each factor multiplies a Joan-scale limit (footFloorMaxM, armClearanceMeshMinM) for THAT character only; no factor = 1.0. Factors are measured from the bound rigs at rest (SOBEKTUNE measure_scale.py: Sobek / roster player): foot length (Foot->ToeBase) 0.309 / 0.169 = 1.83; hips height 1.267 / 0.990 = 1.28 (mesh clearance follows body bulk, not arm length: arm length is 2.13x but would hide real contact). A scale is not a waiver: the sink side of G-plant uses the same factor and the toes still must not go below 0.05 x 1.83 m. armRestSeparationM (SOBEKTUNE v1) = the arm clearance gate only counts arm verts that are at least this far from the torso at rest: the weight-boundary verts touch the torso in the T-pose (0.002 m) and would fail any pose.

floorGate._about: SOBEKGETUP v1: lying/falling/rising clips. The lowest skinned body-mesh vertex (torso, head, legs; verts dominated by fk_* cloth/tail bones or by Shoulder/Arm/ForeArm/Hand bones are left out: long arms reach under the floor in a push-up and are reported, not gated) never goes more than meshSinkMaxM under the floor (= lowest vertex at rest), and the toe base never sinks more than toeSinkMaxM below its rest height. Joan-scale; a scaleProfile multiplies meshSinkMaxM by hipsHeight and toeSinkMaxM by footLen.

player_clearance.note: Joan-owned arm-to-jacket clearance. 0 = raw Mixamo. Raise only with a measured clearance number (see VERIFY). Positive = arms away from the body, Left +/Right - about forward.

scaled_own.note: SOBEKTUNE v1: Sobek-owned arm spread. Tripo torso is bulky, the human-derived Mixamo arms hang pressed to it. armAbductDeg = locomotion clips (about forward, Left +/Right -, same as player_clearance); guard group = swing the elbows out about the up axis (clipAxis, 30 deg; abduction about forward does not move the guard contact, measured 0.003 m at 45 deg). Values measured with Tools/clip_gates arm gap on arm verts that were >= 0.09 m from the torso at rest (SOBEKTUNE diag_arm.py): idle 0.028, walk 0.024, run 0.025, stagger 0.019, strafe 0.019, guard_idle 0.019 vs limit 0.0154.
